components.semantics: Use button for actions and a for navigation.
Use the landmark or sectioning element appropriate to the content.
Associate every control with a label and hints or errors through aria-describedby.
Prefer the native dialog element with an accessible name.
components.enhancement: data-pwf-dialog-open and data-pwf-dialog-close connect controls without inline script.

components.semantics: Use tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles with aria-controls and labelled panels.
components.enhancement: Arrow keys, Home, and End select tabs. Without JavaScript, panels remain visible.

components.semantics: Use caption and scoped header cells; the wrapper only provides horizontal overflow.
Place the visual loader inside an element with role=status and meaningful text.
Messages use polite status announcements; danger messages use alert.
components.enhancement: The API inserts text with textContent and never accepts HTML.
